admission_gates.F1_event_necessity: Primary external biology must support the exact directional event necessity, preferably by exclusion/removal/manipulation rather than raw co-occurrence.
admission_gates.F2_functional_channel: The required role must be definable and measurable as an aggregate biological function without needing post-outcome provider-species enumeration.
admission_gates.F3_operational_relation_keys: An exact or unambiguous site/population unit and event-relevant time window must be available from response-blind metadata.
admission_gates.F4_focal_independence: A focal dataset or data source independent of the relation-defining evidence must contain distinct dependent-event and required-function measurement channels that are not tuned to one another.
admission_gates.F5_functional_absence_adequacy: Metadata must define observation or measurement effort capable in principle of distinguishing functional absence from non-detection; zero observations alone are insufficient.
admission_gates.F6_management_scope: Management, deliberate release, cultivation, or experimental placement must not create the confirmatory relation-space pattern unless the endpoint is explicitly engineering-only.
admission_gates.F7_fresh_endpoint_identity: Previously consumed 284b endpoints and all systems observed during the v1 finite screen are excluded from confirmatory admission.

candidate_registry_rule.hard_stop: Stop when 2 candidates pass F1-F7 or 8 candidates have been screened, whichever happens first.
